_note: Bootstrap peers for a fresh node, keyed by genesis_sha256 (the network discriminator — never chain id alone). Each seed is a genesis validator's address with the host:port its consensus listener answers on; copy them into node.toml as [network] peers + validator_endpoints IN THE SAME ORDER as [validators].set (the node builds its route table from the two lists by position and refuses to boot with no routes). This is the ONE deliberate reachable-address exposure in the bundle. Seeds are published here by the release keyholder as public bootstrap endpoints are opened; an empty list means none are public yet.
